description: Upload a logo/image (base64, PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG, max 5 MB) for use in a design. Returns an assetId; reference it in an image object as { origin:"minio", bucket:"draft", key:"<assetId>" }. Images are re-encoded to PNG server-side (metadata stripped). No URLs — base64 only.

dataBase64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG). No URLs. Max 5 MB decoded.

filename.description: Original file name (label only; format is detected from bytes).

name: upload_asset
